description: This file defines database access functions for a backend service, including schema initialization, data seeding, and various CRUD operations related to bookings, services, device models, and site content, using a Supabase/PostgreSQL database.

methods.name: str _table(name: str)
methods.description: Constructs the full table name, including schema if configured, for database queries.

methods.name: Any _sb()
methods.description: Provides a shortcut to access the cached Supabase client.

methods.name: Any _sb_exec(query)
methods.description: Executes a Supabase query, normalizing the response to return data or raise a RuntimeError on error.

methods.name: None _ensure_catalog_seeded()
methods.description: Performs a best-effort seeding of device brands, models, and repair services into the database if they are not already present.

methods.name: None init_schema()
methods.description: Initializes the database schema and seeds initial data; designed to be resilient and non-crashing at startup.

methods.name: list[dict] list_services()
methods.description: Returns a list of available services for display on the website.

methods.name: list[dict] list_booking_services()
methods.description: Returns a list of repair service options used during booking.

methods.name: list[dict] list_brands()
methods.description: Fetches available device brands for the booking flow.

methods.name: list[dict] list_models_for_brand(brand: str)
methods.description: Fetches available device models for a specified brand.

methods.name: dict get_site_content(keys: list[str])
methods.description: Retrieves key-value site content entries based on provided keys.

methods.name: int create_customer_request(name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str)
methods.description: Creates a new customer request entry and returns its ID.

methods.name: int create_booking(name: str, phone: str, pincode: str)
methods.description: Creates a new booking entry and returns its ID.

methods.name: dict|None update_booking_device_selection( booking_id: int, brand: str | None, model: str | None, service: str | None )
methods.description: Updates device and service selection fields for a specific booking.

methods.name: list[dict] list_bookings(limit: int = 200)
methods.description: Returns recent bookings for administrative purposes.

methods.name: dict|None get_booking_by_id(booking_id: int)
methods.description: Fetches a booking by its ID.

methods.name: dict|None get_latest_booking_by_phone(phone: str)
methods.description: Fetches the latest booking associated with a given phone number.

methods.name: dict|None update_booking_status(booking_id: int, status: str, notes: str | None = None)
methods.description: Updates the status and notes of an existing booking.

methods.name: bool verify_admin_credentials(username: str, password: str)
methods.description: Verifies admin credentials against environment variables; no user table involved.

methods.name: bool is_pincode_serviceable(pincode: str)
methods.description: Checks if a pincode is within the serviceable area based on database data.

ctags.name: create_booking
ctags.pattern: /^def create_booking(name: str, phone: str, pincode: str) -> int:$/

ctags.name: create_customer_request
ctags.pattern: /^def create_customer_request(name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str) /
ctags.signature: (name: str, phone: str, email: str, mobile_model: str, problem: str)

ctags.name: update_booking_device_selection
ctags.signature: ( booking_id: int, brand: str | None, model: str | None, service: str | None )

ctags.name: update_booking_status
ctags.pattern: /^def update_booking_status(booking_id: int, status: str, notes: str | None = None) -> dict | None/
ctags.signature: (booking_id: int, status: str, notes: str | None = None)
